seo.title: Business Software: Replace Spreadsheets With One System
seo.description: Sales, stock, operations and reporting in one system designed around how your business works. Built and supported by Atlaxys Consulting.

hero.title: Replace the spreadsheets with one system that fits your business.
hero.lead: Sales, stock, operations, field teams and reporting in one place, designed around how your team actually works, in French, Arabic or English.
bullets: Designed with the people who will use it
Your existing data moved over for you
Web, desktop or mobile, even offline
hero.whatsappMessage: Hello Atlaxys, I would like to discuss business software for my company.

problem.title: When spreadsheets reach their limit
points: Nobody trusts the numbers because every team has its own file
Stock, orders and invoices never quite match
Only one person knows how the process really works
Off-the-shelf software forces you to change how you work

solution.title: One system, built around how you work
solution.text: We map how your business runs today, then build software that removes double entry and gives everyone the same, up-to-date information.

points.title: Your way of working
points.text: Screens and rules designed around your real process.

points.title: Roles and permissions
points.text: Everyone sees what they need, and nothing more.

points.title: Live reports
points.text: The figures managers check every morning, always up to date.

points.title: Connected tools
points.text: Accounting, payments, online sales and messaging connected.

items.title: One set of numbers
items.text: Every team works from the same data.

items.title: Less typing, fewer errors
items.text: Information entered once and reused everywhere.

items.title: Software you own
items.text: No per-user licence fees that grow with your team.

proof.title: We build our own products too
proof.text: Alongside custom projects, we build and maintain business software of our own, such as:

steps.title: Visit and mapping
steps.text: We see how your team works today.

steps.title: Written scope
steps.text: Screens, rules, connected tools and an estimate in phases.

steps.title: Build in cycles
steps.text: A new working version to test every one to two weeks.

steps.title: Data transfer and training
steps.text: Your data moved over and your team trained.

items.question: Can you import our existing Excel data?
items.answer: Yes. Moving your data is planned as part of the project, and the results are checked against your own totals.

items.question: Can it work without internet?
items.answer: Yes, when needed. Desktop and mobile apps can work offline and sync once the connection is back.

items.question: Who maintains the system?
items.answer: We offer maintenance and support plans, or a documented handover to your own team.
